title: NSB section-10 fused milestone: movable, recolourable, sonically spatialised object

scope.objective: First integrated proof exercising four Goya ideas simultaneously and live: relativistic geometry (presented rect), chromatic polarity with brand lock, ARSEM pan following presentation, NSB retargetable bridges, plus RPI probability field and speculation commit gating.
exclusions: PipeWire audio output (wave 2a) — sonic path verified through pan/gain maths only

implementation_record.notes: fusion binary: click sends object across (retargetable spring bridge); drag moves continuously; theme chip flips polarity; pan derived from presented rect each frame. Programmatic checks: RPI conditional probability (0.70), retarget continuity (no snap), pan-tracks-presentation (delta 1.700 from target pan), brand hue preserved across polarity, surface changes, speculation commit/reject gating. Live: 1800 interactive frames on Wayland.

infrastructure.push: integration/goya-wave-01 pushed to origin via kaptaind push (status ok)
